title.zh: 移民（规定执法机构）条例 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Immigration (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agencies) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 31 December 2024.
2. Each of the authorities and persons specified in the Schedule is a prescribed law enforcement agency for the purposes of sections 51AB and 51AD of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
Part 1
Specified authorities
1.Central Narcotics Bureau
2.Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
3.Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau
4.Gambling Regulatory Authority of Singapore
5.Health Sciences Authority
6.Info‑communications Media Development Authority
7.Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore
8.Land Transport Authority of Singapore
9.Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
10.National Environment Agency
11.National Parks Board
12.Postal Authority appointed under section 3(1) of the Postal Services Act 1999
13.Singapore Civil Defence Force
14.Singapore Customs
15.Singapore Food Agency
16.Singapore Prison Service
17.Singapore Tourism Board
Part 2
Specified persons
1.Chief Executive of the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
2.Chief Executive of the Gambling Regulatory Authority of Singapore
3.Chief Executive of the Health Sciences Authority
4.Chief Executive of the Info‑communications Media Development Authority
5.Chief Executive of the Land Transport Authority of Singapore
6.Chief Executive of the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
7.Chief Executive of the National Environment Agency
8.Chief Executive of the National Parks Board
9.Chief Executive of the Singapore Food Agency
10.Chief Executive of the Singapore Tourism Board
11.Commissioner of Parks and Recreation appointed under section 4(1) of the Parks and Trees Act 2005
12.Comptroller of Income Tax, Deputy Comptroller and Assistant Comptroller, appointed under section 3(1) of the Income Tax Act 1947
13.Director of Marine and Deputy Director of Marine, appointed under section 4(1) of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995
14.Director‑General, Animal Health and Welfare appointed under section 3(1) of the Animals and Birds Act 1965
15.Director‑General, Food Administration appointed under section 3(1) of the Sale of Food Act 1973
16.Director‑General, Wildlife Management appointed under section 4(1) of the Wildlife Act 1965
17.Director‑General, Wildlife Trade Control appointed under section 3(1) of the Endangered Species (Import and Export) Act 2006
18.Director‑General of Environmental Protection appointed under section 3(1) of the Environmental Protection and Management Act 1999
19.Director‑General of Public Health appointed under section 3(1) of the Environmental Public Health Act 1987
20.Port Master and Deputy Port Master, appointed under section 15 of the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore Act 1996
21.Registrar of Vehicles, Deputy Registrar and assistant registrar, appointed under section 9 of the Road Traffic Act 1961
